prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one game ability VFX token atlas, 1024x1024 square RGBA with a truly transparent background. Exactly FOUR isolated hand-painted fantasy effect emblems in an exact evenly spaced 2 by 2 cell grid. Cell centers at 25% and 75% of image width/height. Keep each emblem entirely within the central 65% of its cell, with transparent gutters and no crossing between cells. No text, labels, frames, circles around icons, UI buttons, background, full characters, numbers, decorative borders, shadows or scenery. These are small rendered effect tokens and HUD icons; actual range shapes are rendered separately by the game. Strong distinct silhouette, detailed painted material, restrained glow, readable at 32px. Avoid large opaque panels. Depict characteristic tools/energy/material symbols, not a screenshot or miniature scene. Cell order: TOP LEFT passive, TOP RIGHT skill1, BOTTOM LEFT skill2, BOTTOM RIGHT ultimate. Original avatar: Vesper Loom. Character visual motifs: elderly spider-silk surgeon with mechanical needle-fingers, a cracked porcelain medical mask and lilac thread reservoirs.
TOP LEFT: Recorded Injury. Ability concept: 16% of damage suffered by a nearby marked ally is logged as Care Debt for 3 s, capped at 180 per ally. This does not reduce damage by itself.
TOP RIGHT: Suture Tag. Ability concept: marks an ally for 4 s; the next qualifying damaging hit is reduced by 15%, and the prevented amount becomes Care Debt (not immediate HP).
BOTTOM LEFT: Stitch Circuit. Ability concept: links two allies in range for 2.5 s; healing applied to either is split 70/30 with the other. Link breaks beyond 180 GU. No death prevention.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Emergency Triage. Ability concept: converts up to 200 total Care Debt among nearby allies into a 4 s heal-over-time. Vesper suffers 15% of the converted amount as **nonlethal self-damage** over 4 s. Saves require setup and expose the healer.
